description: Mapping 10-m Industrial Lands across 1000+ Global Large Cities, 2017–2023 is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Cheolhee Yoo et al. Industrial lands, as a key component of economic development, pose great environmental challenges, which motivates global monitoring to support sustainable urban development. Despite this importance, global city-level maps of industrial land use, especially over multiple years, have been lacking. Coverage: global; published in 2025. Formats: Excel, GeoTIFF, ZIP. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support industrial-facility and resource studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
